name: Capability-Gated Action Handoff
purpose: Prepare an idempotent, expiring action request for a host-owned capability after a recommendation and hard-constraint gate pass.
inputs: fresh host capability and authorization assessment
outputs: prepared host action request, approval-required request, abstention, block, or review-required result
invariants: company_id is the sole canonical company boundary
only a recommended option that passed the ready constraint gate can produce a request
unknown or expired host capability assessments fail closed
the host remains authoritative for identity, permission, approval, policy, storage, and execution
the request is not dispatched by this engine
every result and prepared request has authority_effect none
same decision and action payload produce a stable idempotency key
prepared requests expire no later than the host assessment or configured request lifetime

statuses.prepared: A fresh host assessment reports available and allowed; the request is still undispatched and the host must revalidate before dispatch.
statuses.approval_required: A fresh host assessment says approval is needed; the request is prepared for the host approval flow and cannot be dispatched by this engine.
statuses.abstained: The recommendation or constraint gate did not select an executable option.
statuses.blocked: The selected option is ineligible, the binding does not match it, the capability is disabled, or the host denies authorization.
statuses.review_required: The recommendation, hard-constraint gate, action binding, capability availability, or authorization evidence is unresolved.

host_responsibilities: map recommended options to capability/action bindings
recheck policy and expiry before dispatch
execute through the authoritative capability owner and record a receipt
